blocks.text: The Unnecto Bolt 10 is designed for maximum flexibility and efficiency. The Bolt 10 is both unlocked and dual SIM, making it perfect for users who need to manage multiple numbers or travel internationally. The latest version of Android delivers a smooth, responsive experience with all the features and security updates you expect. The 6.56” HD+ display offers clear and vibrant visuals, whether you're streaming content, browsing, or gaming. With 4GB of RAM and an additional 8GB of virtual RAM, this phone allows for seamless multitasking and swift app performance. The 128GB of internal storage provides ample space to store your apps, photos, music, and videos, so you can keep everything you need on hand. With a 2-day battery life, this smartphone ensures you stay connected and productive without the constant need for charging, perfect for those on the go. The built in NFC allows for quick and secure contactless payments and effortless data sharing between devices. The 16MP dual-camera setup captures sharp, clear photos, offering versatility for various shooting conditions. Whether you're capturing memories, staying connected, or getting work done, this smartphone combines performance and convenience, making it a great option for those looking for a reliable and feature-packed smartphone.

items.label: Compatibility
items.value: Compatible with T-Mobile, Metro, Mint, Ultra, and Ting. If your carrier is not listed, please confirm compatibility with your preferred carrier. This device is not compatible with networks like AT&T, Cricket, Verizon, or Tracfone and does not include a SIM card. If you are transferring your SIM card from an existing device, contact your carrier to confirm required steps to activate your new phone.

items.label: Capture Every Moment
items.value: The 16 MP dual camera delivers stunningly sharp and detailed photos, capturing every nuance with incredible clarity, while offering versatile shooting options for any lighting or scene. The 8MP front camera has you covered from selfies to video calls.

items.label: Keeps Pace with You
items.value: Access your phone quickly with the fingerprint scanner. Use the built in NFC for fast, secure wireless transactions, payments, and data transfers with just a tap. Never worry about running out of battery with a multi-day battery that ensures you stay connected and productive for longer wherever you go.

items.label: Multitasking Without Limits
items.value: experience the speed and multitasking prowess of up to 12GB of RAM when the 3GB of VRAM are enabled to complement the 4GB of RAM that comes standard.

items.label: Photos, Apps, and More
items.value: with 128GB of internal storage and an additional 256GB of expandable storage with a microSD card, the Bolt 10 offers the flexibility to expand your device's capacity, providing additional space for photos, videos, and files without compromising performance.
